name: Citizenship by Marriage to a Cypriot Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being married to a Cypriot citizen for at least 3 years.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married to the Cypriot-citizen spouse for 3 years.

sources.title: GK Law Firm -- Cyprus Citizenship New Law: 4 and 5 years criteria

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Cyprus's initial build. Kept as its own route rather than a group within cy_naturalisation since the source explicitly describes it as a different legal track entirely (a 3-year marriage test, not a years-in-Cyprus residence test) -- it is not clear from this pass's sources whether physical residence IN Cyprus during the marriage is itself required, or only the marriage's duration; not asserted either way. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: gov.cy pages were not reachable (403) in this pass; sourced from a single tier-3 article, not independently cross-verified against a second source in this pass (unlike Croatia's and Estonia's equivalent figures, which had multiple corroborating sources).
